title: Enhanced prediction of breast cancer patient response to chemotherapy by integrating deconvolved expression patterns of immune, stromal and tumor cells.
summary: The study describes deconvolution plus supervised models over three breast-cancer cohorts (255 patients) to predict chemotherapy response and identify cell-type/interactions associated with response; performance assessed across cohorts against bulk-expression baseline. Limited retrospective predictive finding; no causal treatment benefit claimed.
